title: 1.1 Points, Lines, and Planes

icans: I can name points, lines, and planes, and tell when points are collinear or coplanar.
I can name segments, rays, and opposite rays.
I can describe the intersection of lines and planes.

vocab: points that lie in the same __________
part of a line that consists of two ____________ and all the points between them
part of a line that ___________ of an endpoint and all the points on one side of it
two rays that share an ___________ and form a line
the set of points that two or more __________ have in common

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Undefined terms: a point has no size; a line extends in _______________ directions with no end; a plane is flat and extends in all directions.

blocks.stem:

notes: Naming segments and rays: A̅B̅ is the segment; ray AB starts at _______________ and goes through B forever.

blocks.stem:

notes: Intersections: two lines intersect in a _______________; two planes intersect in a _______________.
